provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Zal’tharuun is centered at -60.995070, -104.773998 under Tribal Confederation, with 81,309,000 people across 14 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Zal’tharuun occupies 10,763,398.02 sq mi / 27,877,072.91 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 5.465387% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Ocean Surface floating settlement and Farming define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Ocean Surface floating settlement, Beach and grass with water, Hybrid tree and forest floor, Underwater without reefs, Partial forest, and 1 more. Population density is 2.917 people/sq km / 7.554 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Elemental and Energy-Born Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Triton, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Hadozee, Merfolk, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Obsidian Diadem, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Enkirael, Freyseth, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Bastveig, Sigrananna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 5 recorded four-province geography group links, including 4 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Aaron Vaelriven
npcs.description: Aaron Vaelriven uses the warmth of a radio performer and a tailor’s patience to hide how violently his wild magic answers fear. As a half elf of Pallid Elf descent, he reads moonlit symbols, thread-signs, and ichor-stained ledgers with an intuition that frightens even him. He wants to protect Caelthir without being treated like a weapon, which makes every secret he keeps both tender and dangerous.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Vaerûn-Keth is a Village in Zal’tharuun, under Tribal Confederation, with moderate danger, Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water, Farming terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Half Elf reads through the Half-Elf (choose an Elf Bloodline) entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. Half-elves are dual-natured beings born of human and elven lineage, often balancing ambition with longevity. They tend to struggle with identity but excel at diplomacy, adaptability, and bridging cultures. Table cues: +2 Charisma, +1 to Two Other Ability Scores, Darkvision, Fey Ancestry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Neutral.
rumors: Aaron Vaelriven knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Ishtaday.
Aaron Vaelriven has a contact in Virelyss who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Aaron Vaelriven asks the party to quietly protect Caelthir after a broadcast performance causes Final Seal glyphs to appear in the studio glass.
A Melinoe-touched ichor broker offers Aaron control over his magic if he steals a sealed The Brass Concordat ledger before Caelthir can decode it.

npcs.name: Caelthir Vaelriven
npcs.description: Caelthir Vaelriven speaks with calm precision on public broadcasts, but his real work is decoding sealed ruins, death-ledger anomalies, and repeated symbols tied to the prison-systems beneath Belavadös. As a Pallid Elf and Soulbound Continuity vessel, he remembers fragments of battles, vaults, and failures that his present life never lived. He protects Aaron with disciplined devotion, but his secrecy risks turning brotherly love into another form of containment.
